title: Natural Born Killas (NBK) have dropped their latest track, "I Courtney Love You," and it's a must-listen for fans of raw, unfiltered rap.
htmlContent:
The self-made group comprises a rotating cast of brothers, with Yung Hannibal and WolfKnox at the core. Yung Hannibal, who started as a producer and studio engineer, has spent years refining his craft and honing his talent as a creative. This dedication to his work shines through on "I Courtney Love You," which boasts professional-grade production while remaining entirely DIY.

The track is a hard-hitting rap anthem, with NBK showcasing its lyrical prowess and fearlessness. The title alone is a bold statement, and the song lives up to the hype, delivering hard-hitting rhymes over a menacing beat.

Overall, "I Courtney Love You" is a standout track that showcases NBK's talent and commitment to its craft. If you're a raw, unapologetic rap fan, this song is not to be missed.
